lines.en: I sweep through the light at the lake's heart.

lines.zh: 我和同族排成松散的队
lines.en: My school spreads out in a loose line.

lines.zh: 半格长的身体在水里一转
lines.en: My half-block body turns in the water.
My slender snout breaks the surface first.
I skim the sandy lakebed.

lines.zh: 身后的同族跟着我的路线
lines.en: The school follows my path.
Water passes my gills.
I circle a sunken log.
I drift a little shallower.
One flick of the tail and I turn.
Shadows on the bottom move with me.
I pass through a patch of weeds.

lines.zh: 我游得不快,但一直在动
lines.en: I swim slowly, but never still.
The school scatters, then rejoins.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口带泥味的水
lines.en: I take a mouthful of earthy water.
It is quiet beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里,和同伴一起
lines.en: I hang in the water with my school.

lines.zh: 细吻朝着水流来的方向
lines.en: My snout points upstream.
My gill covers open and close.

lines.zh: 湖底的光斑在我背上晃
lines.en: Light dapples across my back.

lines.zh: 身后有同伴擦过我的尾
lines.en: A schoolmate brushes my tail.
I float without moving.
These weeds give enough cover.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个很小的角度
lines.en: I turn a very small angle.

lines.zh: 湖水的味道没什么变化
lines.en: The water's taste has not changed.
I stay by a schoolmate's flank.
This lake is not deep.
I spread my pectoral fins to steady.
The lakebed sand is soft.
I wait for a shadow on the surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子游了一圈。
lines.en: I swim a circle along your shadow.
I tilt up toward the surface.
Your reflection is far larger than a fish.
I peer out from the weeds.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往深处退了一点
lines.en: I ease a little deeper.
Something is moving up there.
I cannot tell what you are doing.
My school has scattered.
I stop at the edge of your shadow.
The water hides me best.
I roll over once.
A scale has been scraped off.
My gill rhythm breaks.
My long snout strikes a stone.

lines.zh: 这一下在水里传得很远
lines.en: That shock carries far through the water.
My school has scattered.
I steady myself with my tail.
There is a taste of blood in the water.
I can still swim fast.
I settle on the sand a moment.
There is a faint taste in the water.
I swing my tail that way.
I flick my tail toward that smell.
There is not enough to share.
I swim under the shadow.
Something has fallen.
I open my mouth for one taste.
The current carries the scent.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等着碎屑落下来。
lines.en: Mouth open, I wait for crumbs to fall.
This is sinking.
I bump into a schoolmate.
The school's line breaks.
I turn back and keep swimming.
A bump in water is nothing.
I strike a stone.
The current shoves me off course.
My schoolmate is swept along.
Only a small splash.
We are crowded together.

lines.zh: 义县的湖里，我们成群游。
lines.en: In Yixian lakes we swim in shoals.
We swim side by side.
My tail brushes yours.

lines.zh: 队伍里只有我们两个落后
lines.en: Only we two lag behind the school.
It is quiet deep in the weeds.
We circle the same sunken log.

lines.zh: 水流会带走我们的气味
lines.en: The current carries our scent away.
Swim ahead; I follow.
This little bay is enough for us.
Let us rise and look at the light.
No words are needed.
I snap at it once.
Too small to notice going down.
I spit it out; not food.
I nudge it on my snout tip.
It has sunk to the bottom.
My schoolmates have gathered.
This one is bright in the water.
I swim one circle around it.
I decide to leave it alone.
I will watch it for now.
Something moves at the surface.
I swim toward that brightness.
That shape is not a leaf.
I stop in the middle water.
The school scatters to both sides.
I line my tail up to the direction.
Distances are short in water.

lines.zh: 我看见了水面下的一点银光。
lines.en: I catch a glint of silver under the surface.
Then I move first.
This target is not large.
I approach from below.
The ripples will cover me.
I follow the shadow on the water.

lines.zh: 你一动,水就把方向告诉我
lines.en: Move, and the water tells me which way.
I am under your reflection.

lines.zh: 我保持在半格深的距离
lines.en: I keep half a block of distance.

lines.zh: 我的吻很细,不容易被看见
lines.en: My snout is thin, hard to see.
My school waits behind me.
The surface is becoming unsteady.
I circle, narrowing the ring.
You are in the shallows, where I am faster.

lines.zh: 我的吻很细，不容易被看见。
lines.en: My snout is slender, hard to notice.
My gills have slowed.
The moment is nearly here.
I press to the edge of your shadow.
I flick my slender snout up.
The surface suddenly bursts.
I bite, and it slips away.
The bite is small, but quick.
I flick my tail and retreat.
My school rushes in together.
I only manage to take a piece.
Water splashes onto the bank.
I turn once and try again.
My teeth are very small.
I slap my tail, throwing up spray.
I sink down into the deep.
A ring spreads on the lake's surface.
I come out of the weeds.
A school fans out behind me.

lines.zh: 半格长的身体在光里一亮
lines.en: My half-block body flashes in the light.
My long snout probes the surface.

lines.zh: 白垩纪义县组的水,还是这个味道
lines.en: Cretaceous Yixian water still tastes the same.
I circle the lake's heart once.
We stir the sand on the bottom.
This lake is ours.
Sunlight comes down from above.
I give one flick of my tail.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边,我们看着你
lines.en: You stand on the bank; we watch you.
I move toward the shallows.
There is food here.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来,我往深处钻
lines.en: The surface heats; I dive deep.
Something crashed into the water above me.
Born to water, yet I am smothering.

lines.zh: 水被炸开,我翻了好几圈
lines.en: The water bursts and I spin.
Something pierced into the water.
That light will not disperse in water.
Too hungry to move my tail.

lines.zh: 雷打进湖里,我整条身子发麻
lines.en: Lightning hits the lake and numbs me.
There is no water at all here.
